topic: Kublai Khan's fleet vs Japan, 1281 (kamikaze typhoon)

beats.text: 1281. You're a soldier in Kublai Khan's fleet, sailing to conquer Japan.

scene.src: commons:Samurai Takezaki Suenaga detail Mōko Shūrai Ekotoba.jpg

beats.text: Over 4,000 ships, one of history's biggest fleets.
Your goal: land at Hakata Bay and take the island.

scene.src: commons:Mōko Shūrai Ekotoba Mongol Invasion Mitsui Sukenaga.jpg

beats.text: Danger one: a new stone wall now lines the beach.
Danger two: samurai row out at night and raid your ships.
Danger three: many ships are rushed river boats, with flat hulls.
Then a typhoon hits and wrecks the fleet. Japan calls it kamikaze, the divine wind.

scene.src: commons:Kikuchi Yoosai - Mongol Invasion (mōko shūrai) - Tokyo National Museum.jpg

beats.text: Would YOU survive? Type SURVIVE or DEAD.
